contents: Run-of-record outputs of the disjoint-pool robustness analysis: cosine contrast and summary tables, half-pool transfer summary, half-swap stability, near-duplicate scan, and per-model half-probe directions (half_directions.npz) with their fit metadata (fit_meta.json).

design.fact_universe: 306 label==1 statements (the generic loader's exact filter); duplicate-equivalent facts grouped so no group spans halves (~153 facts per half)
design.matched_half_a: all probes trained on fact half A (same facts across languages, half-size pool)
design.matched_half_b: all probes trained on fact half B
design.disjoint: cross probes from half B against half-A baselines — zero shared training facts between any compared pair
design.structural_note: D_AB + D_BA = M_A + M_B is an algebraic identity for any scorer, so a symmetrized matched-vs-disjoint transfer contrast is tautologically zero. The eval set's externality means each marginal AUROC cannot be item-inflated. Train-item sharing CAN inflate cross-language probe SIMILARITY — readout 1 (cosine contrast) is the decisive test; the 'difference' condition is exactly a B-vs-A half-swap stability/noise diagnostic, never overlap evidence.

interpretation_prespecified.primary: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: the cosine contrast reported as all per-seed values plus mean, SD and range (the ten seeds are overlapping partitions of one fact pool, not independent datasets; no CI-like interval is computed and no binary verdict is emitted)
interpretation_prespecified.reference_scale: the within-language split-half cosine decrement already on record (results/workshop/probe-reliability: 1 - cos ~= 0.04-0.08) is the natural yardstick for reading the contrast's magnitude — context, not a pass/fail test
interpretation_prespecified.note: an earlier -0.05 cosine margin was removed: it 'mirrored' the AUROC noninferiority margin, but the metrics have unrelated scales. A zero-crossing seed interval is NOT evidence of equivalence.
interpretation_prespecified.disjointness_claim: disjoint row IDs with duplicate-equivalent facts grouped (multilingual union + frozen manual list) — not absolute semantic independence

provenance_note: The per-model fit_meta.json files are the unmodified records of the original runs. Identifiers inside them (code hashes, git commit) describe the authors' execution environment at run time, not files in this repository.
